**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The Agreement imposes no liquidated damages, penalty, or minimum/early-termination fee on us:

- **Section 11 (p0084)** is a bare obligation to pay fees per the Fee Schedule — no penalty or default interest mechanic anywhere in the document (searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty" and "interest" return nothing relevant).
- **Section 17(b) (p0118)** gives us termination for convenience on 90 days' notice with **no** exit fee or remaining-contract-value liability.
- **Section 17(c) (p0128)** and **Section 8 (p0057)** both run in our favour: on Garman's default the licence converts to a perpetual fee-free licence with a refund of fees for services not rendered, and on rejection of the Software Garman refunds all amounts paid.
- **Section 19** non-solicitation is mutual and carries no stipulated damages figure.

No fallback (3-month cap on an early-termination fee) is needed, since no such fee exists to cap.
